verdict.rationale: Postman doesn't clearly document a classic 'interactive API reference with runnable examples' page, but it does offer AI-native access surfaces — an MCP Generator that turns Postman API Network APIs into runnable MCP tools, and 'Agent Mode' for natural-language request execution — which partially satisfy an AI agent's need to explore and run API examples. A live probe confirms a real (auth-gated) MCP endpoint, showing this is functional, not just marketing.
